description: This file provides a WebSocket client helper module for order tracking in a food delivery frontend application. It includes functions to construct WebSocket URLs based on environment variables and to create WebSocket connections for tracking specific orders, handling connection lifecycle events.

methods.name: toWsBaseFromHttp(base)
methods.description: Converts an HTTP/HTTPS URL to a WebSocket URL by replacing the scheme and normalizing the URL base.

methods.name: deriveWsBase()
methods.description: Determines the WebSocket base URL based on environment variables or defaults.

methods.name: normalizeTrackingBase(wsBase)
methods.description: Normalizes the WebSocket base URL to ensure it ends with /tracking/ws, adding segments if necessary.

methods.name: buildTrackingWsUrl(orderId, token = null)
methods.description: Builds a full WebSocket URL for order tracking by combining the normalized base with the order ID and optional token.

methods.name: createTrackingSocketForOrder({ orderId, token = null, onMessage = () => {}, onOpen = () => {}, onClose = () => {}, onError = () => {} } = {})
methods.description: Creates and returns a WebSocket connection for tracking a specific order, with event handlers for message, open, close, and error events.

ctags.name: createTrackingSocketForOrder
ctags.signature: ({ orderId, token = null, onMessage = () => {}, onOpen = () => {}, onClose = () => {}, onError = () => {} } = {})
